label: Only on AGSIST
note: From the elevator boards AGSIST reads.

facts.sentence: On Thursday, Nov 5, 1,720 of the 1,805 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a lower cash corn bid than Wednesday, 39 a higher one; 207 changed their basis, 24 weaker and 183 stronger.
facts.detail: 46 unchanged; median change 5¢ lower. Biggest state move: Iowa, 5¢ lower (385 elevators). 1 outlier left out.
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-05 vs 2026-11-04, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 6 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 4:16 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 49 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 5: 89 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 5, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.comparison: state median basis against ZCZ26, states with 15+ elevators
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)

facts.sentence: Of 1,813 elevators AGSIST reads with a fresh corn bid on Nov 6, 164 were paying over futures, most of them in Kansas (34).
facts.detail: 1,614 under futures, 35 even. Each board against the futures month it names.
